```{python}
#| label: load-selection
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path

import plotly.express as px
import polars as pl
from great_tables import GT
from IPython.display import display

# Each copied .qmd reads the JSON with the same filename stem beside it.
document = Path(os.environ["QUARTO_DOCUMENT_PATH"]) / os.environ["QUARTO_DOCUMENT_FILE"]
data_path = document.with_suffix(".json")
selection = json.loads(data_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
frontier = pl.DataFrame(selection["frontier"])
```

## Selected policy

Thresholds are compared using cached validation predictions. This report makes no
provider calls. Costs and routing latency are simulations, not measured hybrid runs.

```{python}
if selection["threshold"] is None:
    print("No threshold met the quality constraint.")
else:
    print(f"Selected threshold: {selection['threshold']:.2f}")
    print(f"Macro F1: {selection['macro_f1']:.4f}")
    print(f"Fallback fraction: {selection['fallback_fraction']:.1%}")
    print(f"Expected cost (USD): ${selection['expected_cost']:.6f}")
print(f"Baseline macro F1: {selection['baseline_macro_f1']:.4f}")
print(f"Maximum F1 degradation: {selection['max_f1_degradation']:.4f}")
```

## Cost and quality

Green points meet the predefined macro-F1 degradation constraint. The selected
threshold minimizes cost among qualifying points; ties use the smaller threshold.

```{python}
#| label: fig-frontier
#| fig-cap: "Expected USD cost versus macro F1 on validation data."
if frontier.is_empty():
    print("No thresholds were evaluated.")
else:
    points = frontier.with_columns(
        pl.when(pl.col("qualifies")).then(pl.lit("Meets constraint"))
        .otherwise(pl.lit("Below constraint")).alias("Quality")
    )
    fig = px.scatter(
        points, x="expected_cost_usd", y="macro_f1", color="Quality",
        color_discrete_map={"Meets constraint": "#167d32", "Below constraint": "#b23a2b"},
        labels={"expected_cost_usd": "Expected cost (USD)", "macro_f1": "Macro F1"},
        hover_data={"threshold": ":.2f", "fallback_fraction": ":.1%"},
    )
    fig.add_hline(
        y=selection["baseline_macro_f1"] - selection["max_f1_degradation"],
        line_dash="dash", annotation_text="Minimum qualifying F1",
    )
    fig.update_layout(height=420)
    fig.show(renderer="notebook")
```

## Evaluated thresholds

```{python}
if not frontier.is_empty():
    # Show every candidate, including policies that fail the quality constraint.
    display(GT(frontier).fmt_number(
        columns=["threshold", "macro_f1", "fallback_fraction", "coverage", "expected_cost_usd"],
        decimals=4,
    ))
```
